get_lr_at_iter: get the learning rate at a given training iteration using configured solver settings and warmup policy
lr_func_steps_with_lrs: compute the learning rate at a given iteration using predefined step boundaries and explicit LR values
lr_func_steps_with_decay: compute the learning rate at a given iteration using step boundaries with exponential gamma decay
lr_func_cosine_decay: compute the learning rate at a given iteration using a cosine annealing schedule over max iterations
get_lr_func: retrieve the learning rate policy function by name from the configured solver LR_POLICY setting
